name: Rachel Windsor
original_name: レイチェル・ウィンザー
source:
Rachel is a princess from Windsor Country (which looks exactly like the UK) and she is actually engaged to some man called Chris. She is the tsundere of the game but her dere side is really cute too! She fights with a sword and is actually REALLY good. Her rival is [url=/c1180]Mirai[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.livejournal.com/1263.html]Liemyx's review[/url].]
